top_signals.title: Fed Dissents Show Migration Toward Hike, JPMorgan's Michele Says
top_signals.summary: Bob Michele, JPMorgan Asset Management's global head of fixed income, reacts to the decision by the Federal Reserve's policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee to leave rates unchanged. He speaks on Bloomberg Television's "The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Gold Advances After Fed Leaves Interest Rates Unchanged
top_signals.summary: Gold advanced after the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged while repeating the central bank’s pledge to “deliver price stability.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Cyberattack hits Angola’s largest telco hours before landmark stock debut
top_signals.summary: Angola’s largest telecommunications operator, Unitel, was hit by a cyberattack that has left millions of people nationwide without voice services, mobile data, and internet access.
